West Vault holds 100% interest in the Hasbrouck Gold Project. With 561,000 recoverable gold ounces, robust economics and ready-to-build status in Nevada (1), Hasbrouck is a rare low-risk gold investment opportunity.

Through Hasbrouck, West Vault aims to maximize shareholder value through a low-risk gold-in-the-ground strategy focused on acquiring, advancing, de-risking, holding, and selling high-quality development gold projects in the best jurisdictions.
